results.title: Mumbai to host sixth Earthshot Prize Awards on November 17; organisers promise biggest edition yet
results.content: The Earthshot Prize, founded by Prince William in 2020, identifies and supports environmental solutions across five categories. Each of the five winners will receive £1 million to help scale their innovations.

results.title: India’s health spending triples to ₹4.14 lakh crore, but out-of-pocket share drops to 42.7%: NHA
results.content: The share of healthcare costs borne by households fell from 64.2% to 42.7% over a decade, while social security spending on health rose from 6% to 11%

results.title: India, U.S. agreed on preferential market access for Indian goods in America: Goyal
results.content: The deal was to be signed earlier, but changes in U.S. tariff landscape led to further negotiations on the agreement

results.title: India, Bangladesh leaderships should support temporary renewal of Ganga Water Treaty, says expert
results.content: Full revision of the Ganga Water Treaty is not possible in the four weeks left before it expires, says Manjur Ahmed Chowdhury, former Chairman of the National River Conservation Commission of Bangladesh, but ‘having a bad treaty is better than not having any treaty at all’

results.title: ‘Escaping extreme poverty and Naxalism has improved tribal lives’, says PM Modi
results.content: PM cites World Bank report to claim that 50 crore Indians have escaped extreme poverty over last 12 to 13 years; says 125 districts were Naxal-affected in 2014, as previous regimes closed their eyes to the problem

results.title: Shillong Cherry Blossom Festival 2026: Nelly, Khalid, and Swae Lee headline two days of music
results.content: Shillong’s Cherry Blossom Festival returns November 20–21 at the Madan Kurkalang Sports Complex in Bhoirymbong, showcasing a cross-generational lineup that blends international stars like Nelly, Khalid, Swae Lee, Boys Like Girls, and Elliot James Reay with Indian singer Darshan Raval
